verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own pages say Copilot can automate repetitive tasks without coding. They also say Cowork can take on bigger multi-step tasks and deliver completed to-dos, which suggests some delegated autonomous work. However, nothing documents setting up persistent, scheduled or triggered automations that run in the background. Browse with Copilot is a one-off, supervised session the user watches in real time, not background autonomy. Missing for 10: documented creation of recurring or triggered automations, evidence of execution in the background without the user present, scheduling and management controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A copilot can automate repetitive tasks, no coding required.
With Cowork, Copilot can also help with bigger, multi-step tasks and deliver completed to-dos.
Hand off repetitive work so you can focus on what matters.
